page_title: BOC 3-0 UNI | Bochum v Union Berlin 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Frederik Ronnow makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
90+2' The free kick from long range, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' It's like he was asking for a caution. Kevin Stoger (Bochum) receives a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing.
90' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
89' Union Berlin will take a corner kick.
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Felix Passlack (Bochum) is replacing Cristian Gamboa.
87' Thomas Letsch prepares a substitution. Takuma Asano is replaced by Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum).
85' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
82' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Manuel Riemann intercepts the ball.
79' Referee Sven Jablonski has finally had enough of Nenad Bjelica and brandishes a yellow card at him!
78' 3 - 0 Goal! Kevin Stoger (Bochum) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Frederik Ronnow into the bottom right corner.
78' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
77' It’s a PENALTY to Bochum after the VAR review!
77' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Bochum! Let's see what he decides.
76' PENALTY APPEAL after Matus Bero (Bochum) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch for Kevin Volland.
75' Here is a change. Benedict Hollerbach is going off and Nenad Bjelica gives the last tactical orders to Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin).
74' Takuma Asano (Bochum) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
74' The referee blows his whistle, Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
74' The ball is cleared after Matus Bero (Bochum) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
73' Goncalo Paciencia comes off the pitch to be replaced by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
72' Thomas Letsch has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matus Bero (Bochum) replacing Christopher Antwi-Adjei.
71' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
71' Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) jumps into a tackle and Sven Jablonski signals a foul. It's a free kick to Bochum in a dangerous position.
68' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Noah Loosli (Bochum) for Tim Oermann.

64' Ambitious effort from Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
60' Rani Khedira will be replaced by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin).
60' Nenad Bjelica has decided to make a change. Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) replaces Sheraldo Becker.
60' Substitution. Janik Haberer walks off the pitch and Alex Kral (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
57' Takuma Asano (Bochum) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.

54' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the left side of the target. The assist goes to Christopher Antwi-Adjei and the score changes to 2:0.
51' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
50' Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
49' Union Berlin try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
47' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Kevin Stoger (Bochum), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
47' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle and signals a foul after Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) brought his opponent down. Bochum win a free kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' 1 - 0 Goal! Takuma Asano (Bochum) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper inside the right post. 1:0.
45+5' Now Bochum have a corner.
45+4' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
43' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
42' Sven Jablonski has issued a yellow card to Rani Khedira (Union Berlin).
38' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header, but sent the ball into the stands.
37' A player from Union Berlin commits a rough challenge. Sven Jablonski blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Free kick. Bochum will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
35' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.

33' What a great touch by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin win a corner kick.
33' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
31' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
30' Takuma Asano (Bochum) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the left side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Frederik Ronnow with a brilliant diving save!
29' Bochum earn a corner.

28' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time effort from inside the six-yard box. The ball was aimed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
27' Flag up against Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
26' Takuma Asano (Bochum) meets a cross inside the box, but Frederik Ronnow wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
24' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) for a tough tackle.
18' Takuma Asano (Bochum) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way past the left post.
17' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
13' The game is interrupted.
12' A pass by Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
11' A lofted cross from Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
10' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
9' Bernardo (Bochum) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
8' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) commits a foul during an attacking move.
5' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) trips an opposition player and Sven Jablonski signals a foul.
3' What a chance that is! Kevin Stoger (Bochum) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post.
3' The corner from Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is hurriedly cleared.
1' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) runs onto a good ball played into the box and hits a first-time screamer towards goal, but a defender somehow gets his body in the way and makes the block.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bochum will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
